content: Osisimuwa
Siikhu ya mwanzo ya sumana Jumwaa-phiili supuyeene, Mariyamu Mataleena khulawa ovilalo, khoona liwe ntthile laattiyelaniweeyo khapuri lilaziwevo.
Aphano khutthira khulawa mpakha vahali aariivo Simawu Pheeturu na nakhiyoni nkina, otule Yinsa aari omphetaaye, khuwooza yoori: “Mbwana alaziwamo nkhapuri, khanijuweeni vahali atthiiweevo!”
Pheeturu khulankha na nakhiyoni nkina khulawa mpakha okhapuri.
Oowiiri khulankha eettaka otthira, ila otu nkina khutthira channu khunziti Pheeturu, khwiiya mwanzo woofiya ovilalo.
Khwiinama khutturumelamo, khoona joora, ila khuhivirimo nkhapuri mphule.
Aphano, Simawu Pheeturu otule aari onlottaaye, khufiya khuvira nkhapuri mphule na ye khoona joora etile,
na joora etile yaari veeshwa wa Yinsa, eri yooputaputeliwa eri phantte kiina.
Aphano naye nakhiyoni otule aari mwanzo woofiya khuvira nkhapuri nttumphule, khoona na khukhupali.
Yo nalelo zaari ehinaaweeleye zawaatikhiwa ttakatthiifu, zaari olupaaye yoori yaari ohithajiya Yinsa osisimuwa muufwa.
Yinsa onimpuwelela Mariyamu Mataleena
Anakhiyoni apale khurutela onti theenya.
Ila Mariyamu, khusala nalelo ari vanlako wa khapuri, eettaka olila, khwiinama khuthurumela nkatthi.
Khoona malayikha mawiri awaliye kuwo zoolakala, eekhaliye aphale waariivo mwiili wa Yinsa, mmote ovishwa nkina omoolu.
Aphano malayikha apale khumuuzela yoori: “Weeyo muukha, onlila-ni?” Ye khujipu araka: “Yo anthuula Mbwana aka khulawana safwari zaya na akinjuwa vahali antthiiyeevo.”
Paata ya olupa toowo, khuzukuluwa khumoona Yinsa eemeliye, ila khuhinjuwi yoori ti Yinsa.

Aphano Yinsa khumuuzela yoori: “Weeyo, muukha onlila-ni? Onimweekesa paani?” Ye khusala oopuwela yoori aari namalimela woorotha, khunjipu yoori: “Mwinyi, nkhama mweetta onlazamu, nkakuuzeni vahali mwintthiyeevo, miiyo kilawe kanthuule.”
Yinsa khuri: “Mariyamu!” Ye khuzukuluwa, khulupa khwa luuka ya meepereewu yoori: “Raboni!” (Eriina maana la Mwaaliimu).

Yinsa khulupa yoori: “Ohikikholele, maana nalelo akinarutele wa Paapa. Olawe vakatthi wa attwiizaku wawooze yoori: ‘Miiyo kintta orutela wa Paapa na Papeenu mweeyo, wa Nluku aka na Nluku wenu mweeyo.”
Aphano Mariyamu Mataleena khulawa khuwooza anakhiyoni a Yinsa yoori: “Kamoona Mbwana!” Na khuwooza zooshi epile oziweeyo ti Yinsa.
Yinsa oniwaapuwelela anakhiyoni awe

Njuwa-looveva siikhu ethiitile, siikhu ya mwanzo ya sumana, jumwaa-phiili, anakhiyoni akhusanyeyiye milako ziri zoofukiwa, mwaasa wa owoova mayaahuuti, Yinsa khuvira khweemela vakatthi vaya khuri: “Heeri yiiye vamote na-mweyo!”
Alupiyeevo vitthu epile khuwaathonyeza makhono awe na pavu yawe. Anakhiyoni apale khwiiya ofurahi paata ya omoona Mbwana.
Yinsa khulupa theenya yoori: “Heeri yiiye vamote na-mweyo! Nkhama etthiipo Paapa akirumiyeeyo, na-miyo kinuurumani mweeyo.”
Paata ya olupa toowo khuwaavitelela khuri: “Mwipokhere Rooho Ttakatthiifu.
Amana mwiswaamihi twampi za ntthu, twampi zaya epo eniiya zooswamihiwa, ila amana mwihiswaamihi khazinswamihiwa.”
Yinsa onimpuwelela Tome
Tome, aniitthiwaaye Maphapo, mmote wa anakhiyoni apale khumi na awiri, kaari vamote na anakhiyoni wakathi Yinsa awaapuweleliyeevo.

Anakhiyoni apale akina khumuuza yoori: “Namoona Mbwana!” Ila ye khuri: “Miiyo noohooni mmakhono alama za misumari epile, kitthaamo yaala yaka mphule aakhomeliweemo, na kittha nkhono pavu yawe, hatha vattitthiiru akinkhupali!”
Paata ya ovira siikhu naane anakhiyoni awe khurutela okusanyeya nttumphule theenya na Tome aarivo. Milako ziri zoofukiwa, Yinsa khuta khweemela vakatthi vaya khuri: “Heeri yiiye vamote na-mweyo!”
Aphano Yinsa khumuuza Tome yoori: “Otthe yaala yawo apha, na woone makhono aka, na wookole nkhono awo ottheele pavu yaka. Ohiiye nanhikhupali, ila wiiye namakhupali.”
Tome khujipu araka: “Mbwana aka na Nluku aka!”
Yinsa khumuuza yoori: “Mwaasa wa okoona, wakhupali? Ooparikhiyiwa pi apale ahooneeni ila khukhupali.”
Yinsa khuretta alama za minjuza kiina zinkizene vakatthi wa anakhiyoni zihaatikhiweenimo nkithaapu mphu,
ila epi zaatikhiwa yoori mweeyo mwikhupali yoori Yinsa ti Al-Masiihu, Mwaana wa Nluku na yoori amana mwinkhupali mwiiyane ohaayi khwa nzina lawe.
